pob.text: And it happened after the death of Joshua that the sons of Israel asked Yahweh[a], saying[b], “Who will go up for us first against the Canaanites to fight against them?”

pob.text: And the LORD said, “Judah shall go up. Look, I have given the land into his hand.”

spob.text: The LORD said, “Judah will go up first to fight. Look, I have handed the land over to him.”

pob.text: And Judah said to Simeon his brother[a], “Come up with me into my allotted territory, and let us fight against the Canaanites; and I too will go with you into your allotted territory.” So Simeon went with him.

spob.text: Judah said to his brother Simeon, “Come up with me to my allotted territory, so that together we can fight the Canaanites. I will also go with you to your allotted territory.” So Simeon went with him.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the men of Judah said to their brothers the Simeonites, “Come up with us to our allotted territory, and let us fight against the Canaanites. And we likewise will go with you to your territory.” So the Simeonites went with them.

pob.text: Then Judah went up[a], and Yahweh gave the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand[b], and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.

pob.text: They found Adoni-bezek in Bezek[a], and they fought against him and struck down the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

pob.text: But Adoni-bezek fled[a], and they pursued him, seized him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.

spob.text: But Adoni-bezek ran away. They chased him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.

pob.text: And Adoni-bezek said[a], “Seventy kings, with the thumbs of their hands and their feet cut off, used to gather scraps under my table. As I have done, so God has repaid me.” And they brought him to Jerusalem[b], and he died there.

spob.text: Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off used to pick up scraps under my table. God has repaid me in the same way I treated them.” Then they brought him to Jerusalem, where he died.

pob.text: Then the sons of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it[a], and struck it with the edge of the sword[b], and they set the city on fire.

spob.text: Then the sons of Judah[a] attacked Jerusalem[b]. They captured the city, killed its people with the sword, and set the city on fire.

pob.text: Afterward[a], the sons of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, the Negev, and the lowland.

pob.text: And the descendants of the Kenite[a], Moses’ father-in-law, went up from the City of Palms with the descendants of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the Negev of Arad[d][c][b]; then he went and settled with the people.

public_domain_references.web: The men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued Midian.
public_domain_references.asv: And the men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after Midian.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the host fled as far as Bethseed Tagaragatha Abel-meula to Tabath; and the men of Israel from Nephthali, and from Aser, and from all Manasse, came to help, and followed after Madiam.

pob.text: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim[a], saying, “Come down against Midian, and seize the waters as far as Beth-barah, and the Jordan.” So every man of Ephraim was called out, and they seized the waters as far as Beth-barah[c][b], and the Jordan.

spob.text: Gideon sent messengers throughout all Ephraim’s hill country. They said, “Come down to confront Midian. Seize the waters as far as Beth-barah and the Jordan.”[a] So the men of Ephraim were summoned, and they seized the waters as far as Beth-barah and the Jordan.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Gideon sent messengers throughout the hill country of Ephraim to say, “Come down against the Midianites and seize the waters of the Jordan ahead of them as far as Beth-barah.” So all the men of Ephraim were called out, and they captured the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth-barah.
public_domain_references.web: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.
public_domain_references.asv: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill-country of Ephraim, saying, Come down against Midian, and take before them the waters, as far as Beth-barah, even the Jordan. So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together, and took the waters as far as Beth-barah, even the Jordan.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Beth-barah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Beth-barah and Jordan.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Gedeon sent messengers into all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down to meet Madiam, and take to yourselves the water as far as Bæthera and Jordan: and every man of Ephraim cried out, and they took the water before hand unto Bæthera and Jordan.

pob.text: And they captured the two princes of Midian[a], Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb, and they killed Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. Then they pursued Midian[b], and they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon from across the Jordan.

spob.text: They captured Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian.[a] They killed Oreb at the place called the Rock of Oreb and Zeeb at the place called the Winepress of Zeeb. Then they continued pursuing the Midianites. From across the Jordan, they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: They also captured Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian; and they killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. So they pursued the Midianites and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side of the Jordan.
public_domain_references.web: They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at Oreb’s rock, and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb’s wine press, as they pursued Midian. Then they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.
public_domain_references.asv: And they took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb at the rock of Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian: and they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they took the princes of Madiam, even Oreb and Zeb; and they slew Oreb in Sur Oreb, and they slew Zeb in Jakephzeph; and they pursued Madiam, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeb to Gedeon from beyond Jordan.

pob.text: Then the men of Ephraim said to him[a], “What is this thing you have done to us[b], not calling us when you went to fight against Midian?” And they contended with him strongly.

spob.text: Then the men of Ephraim said to him, “Why did you do this to us? Why didn’t you call us when you went to fight against Midian?” They argued fiercely with him.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the men of Ephraim said to Gideon, “Why have you done this to us? Why did you fail to call us when you went to fight against Midian?” And they contended with him violently.
public_domain_references.web: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.
public_domain_references.asv: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with Midian? And they did chide with him sharply.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the men of Ephraim said to Gedeon, What [is] this [that] thou hast done to us, in that thou didst not call us when thou wentest to fight with Madiam? and they chode with him sharply.

pob.text: But he said to them[a], “What have I done now compared to you? Are not the gleanings of Ephraim better than the grape harvest of Abiezer?”

spob.text: But he answered them, “What have I done that compares with what you have done? Aren’t Ephraim’s leftover grapes better than Abiezer’s[a] grape harvest?”

public_domain_references.bsb: But Gideon answered them, “Now what have I accomplished compared to you? Are not the gleanings of Ephraim better than the grape harvest of Abiezer?
public_domain_references.web: He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
public_domain_references.asv: And he said unto them, What have I now done in comparison with you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
public_domain_references.kjv: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? [Is] not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi-ezer?
public_domain_references.brenton: And he said to them, What have I now done in comparison of you? [is] not the gleaning of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

pob.text: Into your hand God gave the princes of Midian[a], Oreb and Zeeb; and what was I able to do compared with you? Then their spirit relaxed toward him when he spoke this word.

spob.text: “God handed Oreb and Zeeb, the princes of Midian, over to you. What have I done that compares with what you did?” When he said this, their anger toward him subsided.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: God has delivered Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian, into your hand. What was I able to do compared to you?” When he had said this, their anger against him subsided.
public_domain_references.web: God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb! What was I able to do in comparison with you?” Then their anger was abated toward him when he had said that.
public_domain_references.asv: God hath delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison with you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.
public_domain_references.kjv: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord has delivered into your hand the princes of Madiam, Oreb and Zeb; and what could I do in comparison of you? Then was their spirit calmed toward him, when he spoke this word.

pob.text: Then Gideon came to the Jordan and crossed over[a], he and the three hundred men who were with him, exhausted yet pursuing.

spob.text: Gideon reached the Jordan and crossed it with his three hundred men. They were exhausted, but they kept pursuing the enemy.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then Gideon and his three hundred men came to the Jordan and crossed it, exhausted yet still in pursuit.
public_domain_references.web: Gideon came to the Jordan and passed over, he and the three hundred men who were with him, faint, yet pursuing.
public_domain_references.asv: And Gideon came to the Jordan, [and] passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And Gideon came to Jordan, [and] passed over, he, and the three hundred men that [were] with him, faint, yet pursuing [them].
public_domain_references.brenton: And Gedeon came to Jordan, and went over, himself and the three hundred with him, hungry, yet pursuing.

pob.text: And he said to the men of Succoth[a], “Please give loaves of bread to the people who are with me, for they are weary, and I am pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”

spob.text: He said to the men of Succoth, “Please give the people with me some loaves of bread.[a] They are tired, and I am pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”

public_domain_references.bsb: So Gideon said to the men of Succoth, “Please give my troops some bread, for they are exhausted, and I am still pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”
public_domain_references.web: He said to the men of Succoth, “Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”
public_domain_references.asv: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they [be] faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he said to the men of Socchoth, Give, I pray you, bread to feed this people that follow me; because they are faint, and behold, I am following after Zebee and Salmana, kings of Madiam.

pob.text: Then the leaders of Succoth said, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?”

spob.text: Then the leaders of Succoth said, “Are Zebah and Zalmunna already in your power? Why should we give bread to your troops?”

public_domain_references.bsb: But the leaders of Succoth asked, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your possession, that we should give bread to your army?”
public_domain_references.web: The princes of Succoth said, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?”
public_domain_references.asv: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thy hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And the princes of Succoth said, [Are] the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?
public_domain_references.brenton: And the princes of Socchoth said, [Are] the hands of Zebee and Salmana now in thy hand, that we should give bread to thy host?

pob.text: And Gideon said[a], “Therefore, when Yahweh gives Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, I will thresh your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.”

spob.text: So Gideon said, “When Yahweh hands Zebah and Zalmunna over to me, I will beat your flesh as grain is threshed, using thorns and briers from the wilderness.[a]”

public_domain_references.bsb: “Very well,” Gideon replied, “when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, I will tear your flesh with the thorns and briers of the wilderness!”
public_domain_references.web: Gideon said, “Therefore when Yahweh has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.”
public_domain_references.asv: And Gideon said, Therefore when Jehovah hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Gedeon said, Therefore when the Lord gives Zebee and Salmana into my hand, then will I tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness, and the Barkenim.

pob.text: From there he went up to Penuel and spoke to them in the same way[b][a], and the men of Penuel answered him just as the men of Succoth had answered.

spob.text: From there Gideon went up to Penuel[a] and made the same request. The men of Penuel gave him the same answer as the men of Succoth.

public_domain_references.bsb: From there he went up to Penuel and asked the same from them, but the men of Penuel gave the same response as the men of Succoth.
public_domain_references.web: He went up there to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.
public_domain_references.asv: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them in like manner; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered [him].
public_domain_references.brenton: And he went up thence to Phanuel, and spoke to them likewise: and the men of Phanuel answered him as the men of Socchoth [had] answered him.

pob.text: He also said to the men of Penuel[a], “When I return in peace[c][b], I will tear down this tower.”

spob.text: He also told the men of Penuel[a], “When I return safely, I will tear down this tower.”[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: So Gideon told the men of Penuel, “When I return in triumph, I will tear down this tower!”
public_domain_references.web: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”
public_domain_references.asv: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Gedeon said to the men of Phanuel, When I return in peace, I will break down this tower.

pob.text: Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor[a], and their camps were with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left from all the camp of the sons of the east; and those who had fallen were one hundred twenty thousand men drawing the sword.

spob.text: Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor. Their camps were with them and included about fifteen thousand men—all who remained from the whole army of the people of the east.[a] One hundred twenty thousand sword-bearing fighting men had fallen in battle.

public_domain_references.bsb: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with their army of about fifteen thousand men—all that were left of the armies of the people of the east. A hundred and twenty thousand swordsmen had already fallen.
public_domain_references.web: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all the army of the children of the east; for there fell one hundred twenty thousand men who drew sword.
public_domain_references.asv: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the host of the children of the east; for there fell a hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Now Zebah and Zalmunna [were] in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand [men], all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Zebee and Salmana [were] in Carcar, and their host [was] with them, about fifteen thousand, all that were left of all the host of the aliens; and they that fell [were] a hundred and twenty thousand men that drew the sword.

pob.text: Then Gideon went up by the route of those who dwell in tents[a], east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the camp while the camp was unsuspecting.

spob.text: Then Gideon traveled along the route used by people who lived in tents, east of Nobah and Jogbehah. He attacked the camp when its people were not expecting an attack.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And Gideon went up by way of the caravan route east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and he attacked their army, taking them by surprise.
public_domain_references.web: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army; for the army felt secure.
public_domain_references.asv: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host; for the host was secure.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Gedeon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents, eastward of Nabai and Jegebal; and he smote the host, and the host was secure.

pob.text: Zebah and Zalmunna fled[a], and he pursued them and captured the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna; and he threw the whole camp into panic.

spob.text: Zebah and Zalmunna fled. He chased them and captured both kings of Midian. Then he threw the whole camp into panic.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: When Zebah and Zalmunna fled, Gideon pursued and captured these two kings of Midian, routing their entire army.
public_domain_references.web: Zebah and Zalmunna fled and he pursued them. He took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and confused all the army.
public_domain_references.asv: And Zebah and Zalmunna fled; and he pursued after them; and he took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
public_domain_references.kjv: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Zebee and Salmana fled; and he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Madiam, Zebee and Salmana, and discomfited all the army.

pob.text: Then Gideon son of Joash returned from the battle by the ascent of Heres[a].

spob.text: Then Gideon son of Joash returned from the battle by way of the uphill ascent of Heres.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: After this, Gideon son of Joash returned from the battle along the Ascent of Heres.
public_domain_references.web: Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres.
public_domain_references.asv: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun [was up],
public_domain_references.brenton: And Gedeon the son of Joas returned from the battle, down from the battle of Ares.

pob.text: And he captured a young man from the men of Succoth and questioned him[a], and he wrote down for him the officials of Succoth and its elders, seventy-seven men.

spob.text: Gideon captured a young man from Succoth and questioned him. The young man wrote down for Gideon who Succoth’s officials and elders were—seventy-seven men in all.

public_domain_references.bsb: There he captured a young man of Succoth and interrogated him. The young man wrote down for him the names of the seventy-seven leaders and elders of Succoth.
public_domain_references.web: He caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him; and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and its elders, seventy-seven men.
public_domain_references.asv: And he caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him: and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, seventy and seven men.
public_domain_references.kjv: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, [even] threescore and seventeen men.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he took prisoner a young lad of the men of Socchoth, and questioned him; and he wrote to him the names of the princes of Socchoth and of their elders, seventy-seven men.

pob.text: Then he came to the men of Succoth and said[a], “Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are Zebah and Zalmunna already in your hand[b], that we should give bread to your weary men?’”

spob.text: Then he went to the men of Succoth and said, “Here are Zebah and Zalmunna! You taunted me about them when you said, ‘Have you already captured Zebah and Zalmunna[a]? Why should we give bread to your exhausted men?’”

public_domain_references.bsb: And Gideon went to the men of Succoth and said, “Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your possession, that we should give bread to your weary men?’”
public_domain_references.web: He came to the men of Succoth, and said, “See Zebah and Zalmunna, concerning whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your men who are weary?’”
public_domain_references.asv: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, concerning whom ye did taunt me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thy hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?
public_domain_references.kjv: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, [Are] the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men [that are] weary?
public_domain_references.brenton: And Gedeon came to the princes of Socchoth, and said, Behold Zebee and Salmana, about whom ye reproached me, saying, [Are] the hands of Zebee and Salmana now in thy hand, that we should give bread to thy men that are faint?

pob.text: Then he took the elders of the city[a], and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he disciplined the men of Succoth.

spob.text: Then he took the city elders, along with desert thorns and briers. He used the thorny plants to discipline the men of Succoth.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then he took the elders of the city, and using the thorns and briers of the wilderness, he disciplined the men of Succoth.
public_domain_references.web: He took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
public_domain_references.asv: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he took the elders of the city with the thorns of the wilderness and the Barkenim, and with them he tore the men of the city.

pob.text: He tore down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city[a].

spob.text: He tore down Penuel’s tower and killed the men of the city.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: He also pulled down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city.
public_domain_references.web: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.
public_domain_references.asv: And he brake down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he overthrew the tower of Phanuel, and slew the men of the city.

pob.text: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna[a], “Where are the men whom you killed at Tabor?” And they said, “As you are, so were they[b]; each one had the appearance of the sons of a king.”

spob.text: Then he asked Zebah and Zalmunna, “Where are the men you killed at Mount Tabor?” They answered, “They were like you. Each one looked like a king’s son.”

public_domain_references.bsb: Next, Gideon asked Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men did you kill at Tabor?” “Men like you,” they answered, “each one resembling the son of a king.”
public_domain_references.web: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor?” They answered, “They were like you. They all resembled the children of a king.”
public_domain_references.asv: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men [were they] whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou [art], so [were] they; each one resembled the children of a king.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he said to Zebee and Salmana, Where [are] the men whom ye slew in Thabor? and they said, As thou, so [were] they, according to the likeness of the son of a king.

pob.text: And he said[a], “They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As Yahweh lives, if you had let them live[b], I would not have killed you.”

spob.text: He said, “They were my brothers, my mother’s sons. As Yahweh lives, if you had spared them, I would not have killed you.”

public_domain_references.bsb: “They were my brothers,” Gideon replied, “the sons of my mother! As surely as the LORD lives, if you had let them live, I would not kill you.”
public_domain_references.web: He said, “They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As Yahweh lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you.”
public_domain_references.asv: And he said, They were my brethren, the sons of my mother: as Jehovah liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he said, They [were] my brethren, [even] the sons of my mother: [as] the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Gedeon said, They were my brethren and the sons of my mother: [as] the Lord lives, if ye had preserved them alive, I would not have slain you.

pob.text: Then he said to Jether his firstborn[a], “Get up, kill them.” But the young man did not draw his sword, because he was afraid, for he was still a young man.

spob.text: Then he told his firstborn son, Jether, “Get up and kill them.” But the young man[a] did not draw his sword because he was afraid; he was still young.

public_domain_references.web: So Manoah took the young goat with the meal offering, and offered it on the rock to Yahweh. Then the angel did an amazing thing as Manoah and his wife watched.
public_domain_references.asv: So Manoah took the kid with the meal-offering, and offered it upon the rock unto Jehovah: and [the angel] did wondrously, and Manoah and his wife looked on.
public_domain_references.kjv: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered [it] upon a rock unto the LORD: and [the angel] did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Manoë took a kid of the goats and its meat-offering, and offered it on the rock to the Lord; and [the angel] wrought a distinct work, and Manoë and his wife were looking on.

pob.text: And when the flame went up from the altar toward heaven[a], the angel of Yahweh went up in the flame of the altar, while Manoah and his wife were watching[b]; and they fell on their faces to the ground.

spob.text: As Manoah and his wife watched, the flame rose from the altar toward heaven. The angel of Yahweh[a] rose in the altar’s flame, and they fell facedown on the ground.

public_domain_references.bsb: When the flame went up from the altar to the sky, the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame. When Manoah and his wife saw this, they fell facedown to the ground.
public_domain_references.web: For when the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar, Yahweh’s angel ascended in the flame of the altar. Manoah and his wife watched; and they fell on their faces to the ground.
public_domain_references.asv: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of Jehovah ascended in the flame of the altar: and Manoah and his wife looked on; and they fell on their faces to the ground.
public_domain_references.kjv: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on [it], and fell on their faces to the ground.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it came to pass when the flame went up above the altar toward heaven, that the angel of the Lord went up in the flame; and Manoë and his wife were looking, and they fell upon their face to the earth.

pob.text: And the angel of Yahweh did not appear again to Manoah and to his wife[a]. Then Manoah knew that he was the angel of Yahweh.

spob.text: The angel of Yahweh[a] never showed himself to Manoah or his wife again. Manoah then realized who he was: the angel of Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: And when the angel of the LORD did not appear again to Manoah and his wife, Manoah realized that it had been the angel of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: But Yahweh’s angel didn’t appear to Manoah or to his wife any more. Then Manoah knew that he was Yahweh’s angel.
public_domain_references.asv: But the angel of Jehovah did no more appear to Manoah or to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was the angel of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he [was] an angel of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the angel appeared no more to Manoë and to his wife: then Manoë knew that this [was] an angel of the Lord.

pob.text: And Manoah said to his wife[a], “We will surely die, because we have seen God.”

spob.text: Manoah said to his wife, “We are certain to die, because we have seen God.”[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: “We are going to die,” he said to his wife, “for we have seen God!”
public_domain_references.web: Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, because we have seen God.”
public_domain_references.asv: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Manoë said to his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.

pob.text: But his wife said to him, “If the LORD had intended to kill us, he would not have accepted from our hand a burnt offering and a grain offering, or shown us all these things, or now announced to us such a thing as this.”

spob.text: But his wife answered, “If the LORD had wanted to kill us, he would not have accepted our burnt offering and grain offering. He would not have shown us all these things or made this announcement to us now.”

public_domain_references.bsb: But his wife replied, “If the LORD had intended to kill us, He would not have accepted the burnt offering and the grain offering from our hands, nor would He have shown us all these things or spoken to us this way.”
public_domain_references.web: But his wife said to him, “If Yahweh were pleased to kill us, he wouldn’t have received a burnt offering and a meal offering at our hand, and he wouldn’t have shown us all these things, nor would he have told us such things as these at this time.”

public_domain_references.kjv: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these [things], nor would as at this time have told us [such things] as these.

pob.text: And the woman bore a son and called his name Samson. And the boy grew, and Yahweh blessed him.

pob.text: And the Spirit of Yahweh began to stir him in Mahaneh-dan[b][a], between Zorah and Eshtaol.

spob.text: Yahweh’s Spirit began to stir him in Mahaneh-dan,[a] between Zorah and Eshtaol.[b]

pob.text: Then Samson went down to Timnah[a], and at Timnah he saw a woman from the daughters of the Philistines.

spob.text: Then Samson went down to Timnah. There he saw a Philistine woman.

pob.text: Then he went up and told his father and mother[a], and he said, “I saw a woman in Timnah from the daughters of the Philistines. So now, get her for me as a wife.”

spob.text: Then he went up and told his father and mother, “I saw a Philistine woman[a] in Timnah. Now arrange for her to become my wife.”

pob.text: But his father and his mother said to him[a], “Is there not a woman among the daughters of your brothers or among all my people, that you are going to take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines?” But Samson said to his father, “Get her for me[b], for she is right in my eyes.”

spob.text:
But his father and mother said to him, “Isn’t there a woman among your own relatives[a] or among all my people for you to marry, instead of marrying a woman from the uncircumcised Philistines?”

Samson answered his father, “Get her for me, because she is right in my eyes.[b]”

public_domain_references.web: Then his father and his mother said to him, “Isn’t there a woman among your brothers’ daughters, or among all my people, that you go to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines?” Samson said to his father, “Get her for me, for she pleases me well.”

pob.text: But his father and mother did not know that it was from Yahweh[a], for he was seeking an occasion from the Philistines[b]. At that time the Philistines were ruling over Israel.

pob.text: Then Samson went down with his father and his mother to Timnah[a], and they came as far as the vineyards of Timnah. And behold[c][b], a young lion was roaring as it came toward him.

pob.text: Then the Spirit of Yahweh rushed upon him[a], and he tore it apart as one tears apart a young goat, though he had nothing in his hand[b]. But he did not tell his father or his mother what he had done.

spob.text: Then the Spirit of Yahweh came upon Samson with sudden power. Samson tore the lion apart as easily as someone tears apart a young goat, even though he had no weapon. But he did not tell his father or mother what he had done.

pob.text: Then he went down and spoke to the woman[a], and she was pleasing in Samson’s eyes.

pob.text: After some days he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcass of the lion, and behold, a swarm of bees was in the body of the lion, and honey.

pob.text: And when they saw him[a], they took thirty companions, and they were with him.

pob.text: And Samson said to them[a], “Please let me put a riddle to you. If you indeed tell it to me within the seven days of the feast and solve it[c][b], then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes.”

pob.text: And he said to them[a], “Out of the eater came food[b], and out of the strong came sweetness.” But they could not tell the riddle for three days.

spob.text:
He said to them:

“Food came out of the eater,
and sweetness came out of the strong.”[a]

For three days, they could not solve the riddle.

pob.text: And on the seventh day they said to Samson’s wife[a], “Entice your husband so that he may tell us the riddle, lest we burn you and your father’s household with fire[b]. Did you invite us to dispossess us? Is that not so?”

spob.text: On the seventh day, they told Samson’s wife, “Manipulate your husband into telling us the answer to the riddle. If you do not, we will set you and your father’s household on fire.[a] Did you invite us just to take what belongs to us?[b] Isn’t that so?”

public_domain_references.bsb: So on the fourth day they said to Samson’s wife, “Entice your husband to explain the riddle to us, or we will burn you and your father’s household to death. Did you invite us here to rob us?”
public_domain_references.web: On the seventh day, they said to Samson’s wife, “Entice your husband, that he may declare to us the riddle, lest we burn you and your father’s house with fire. Have you called us to impoverish us? Isn’t that so?”

pob.text: Then Samson’s wife wept before him and said[a], “You only hate me; you do not love me. You have posed the riddle to the sons of my people, but you have not told me.” And he said to her, “Look, I have not told my father or my mother, so should I tell you?”

spob.text:
Then Samson’s wife wept over him. She said, “You only hate me; you do not love me! You gave the men of my people a riddle, but you have not explained it to me.”

Samson answered, “Look, I have not even told my father or mother. Why should I tell you?”

public_domain_references.bsb: Then Samson’s wife came to him, weeping, and said, “You hate me! You do not really love me! spob.text: The Israelites then left that place. Each man went to his own tribe and family group and headed for his inherited land.

public_domain_references.bsb: And at that time, each of the Israelites returned from there to his own tribe and clan, each to his own inheritance.
public_domain_references.web: The children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they each went out from there to his own inheritance.
public_domain_references.asv: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the children of Israel went thence at that time every man to his tribe and his kindred; and they went thence every man to his inheritance.

pob.text: In those days there was no king in Israel[a]; each man did what was right in his own eyes.

spob.text: In those days, Israel had no king. Each man did what he thought was right.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: In those days there was no king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
public_domain_references.web: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.
public_domain_references.asv: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
public_domain_references.kjv: In those days [there was] no king in Israel: every man did [that which was] right in his own eyes.
public_domain_references.brenton: And in those days there was no king in Israel; every man did that which was right in his own sight.
